Three-Dimensional Structure Inspection of the Screening Library, Controls and Decoys

PHP–PDE4 project · Phase 1, Steps 7, 8 and 9 · Supporting material

Summary. Three-dimensional conformers were generated from the canonical SMILES of 34 library compounds, 6 positive controls and 350 DUD-E decoys using Open Babel (--gen3d, MMFF94 minimisation). Structures were screened automatically for planarity, atomic overlap and inversion of specified stereocentres; failures were regenerated with RDKit (ETKDGv3, MMFF94). Structures were then inspected visually; the inspection status of each compound is recorded below.
